description: Immutable reviewed lab executor; no arbitrary commands or paths

Bundle.description: Bounded gzip/base64 release envelope; all seven contents pinned by the executor

OperationId.description: Unique workflow run and attempt identifier; repeats fail closed

runCommand:
set -eu
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
unset BASH_ENV ENV PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME LD_PRELOAD LD_LIBRARY_PATH
exec /usr/bin/python3 -I -B - <<'REVIEWED_EXECUTOR'
import base64, json
namespace = {'__name__': 'reviewed_executor'}
exec(compile(base64.b64decode('__EXECUTOR_BASE64__'), '<reviewed-executor>', 'exec'), namespace)
namespace['run'](json.loads(base64.b64decode('__CONTRACT_BASE64__')))
REVIEWED_EXECUTOR
